login.title: Two Towers
login.subtitle: Two Towers — a turn-based strategy on a {size}×{size} board

rules.title: How to play
rules.body:
The goal is to **capture the enemy main castle**.
{size}×{size} board. Each player starts with a main castle in their corner holding {start} soldiers.
**A turn has two phases.** First, reinforcements: {castleIncome} per main castle, {fortIncome} per fort, {cellIncome} per other owned cell — place them on your castle or forts. Then perform one action.
**Actions (one per turn):**
• **Move** — send soldiers to an adjacent cell you own.
• **Occupy** — send soldiers to an adjacent neutral cell. It becomes yours with exactly the soldiers you sent.
• **Attack** — send soldiers to an adjacent enemy cell. You must send more than its defense: soldiers ×{fortDef} on a fort, ×{castleDef} on a main castle. You lose soldiers equal to the defense; the rest capture the cell. A captured fort is destroyed.
• **Build fort** — costs {fortCost} soldiers on the selected cell. At most {maxForts} forts per player.
• **Pass** — skip the action.
Occupied cells stay yours even after all soldiers leave, and they keep producing income.
